title: MDM Changeset
description: How every app writes back: a document of whole-record upserts. Applied with `python tools/mdm.py apply-changeset FILE`, later POSTed to the MDM API unchanged. Deletes are soft: upsert the record with deleted_at set. Optional `base` checksums let the receiver detect that someone else changed a record since the app loaded it (optimistic concurrency) instead of silently overwriting.

id.description: Unique id of this changeset file (UUID), so the same export is never applied twice by mistake.

exported_at.description: When the app exported the changeset (UTC).

source.description: App id or page URL that produced it.

schema_version.description: Master schema version the app was built for, e.g. 2.1.

status.description: AI-produced changesets arrive as draft until a person approves them.

note.description: Free-text note from whoever exported it (what changed and why).

base.description: record id -> checksum_sha256 the app started from.

upserts.description: Whole records (each still validated against its type schema on apply).
